main_measure.name: mean unusual 10-bar move per case, short direction

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm t >= 2 (day-clustered) with larger-minus-smaller half > 0; reject t <= -2

supporting_check.name: larger-half minus smaller-half mean unusual move (|forecast| median split)

decided_by: The t of the mean unusual move lies between -2 and 2.
reading: A case is the first short bet (forecast falling >= 2 points from its lowest short level since the last bet) in each 10-bar grid cell of a window; the median split puts the top floor(n/2) cases by |forecast| (ties ordered by time and coin) in the larger half; the situation uses prices where the lookback fits in the window, else the recorded regime.
